Area Forecast Discussion
National Weather Service Austin/San Antonio TX
531 AM CDT Thu Aug 27 2026

...New AVIATION...

.KEY MESSAGES...
Updated at 525 AM CDT Thu Aug 27 2026

- A Heat Advisory is in effect through this evening for the
  Coastal Plains and I-35 corridor.

- Low to medium rain/storm chances for most areas Thursday and 
  some locations Friday. Otherwise, hot and predominantly dry 
  weather persists.

&&

.SHORT TERM...
(Today through Friday)
Issued at 1220 AM CDT Thu Aug 27 2026

Ridging will continue to very gradually move westward today, 
eventually centering itself near the New Mexico/Arizona boarder. 
Flow aloft turns northerly to northwesterly in this pattern 
allowing some disturbances to ride the eastern periphery of the 
ridge. This brings both increased moisture and rain chances to the
majority of South Central Texas today. Increased moisture and 
forecast highs in the 90s to around 103 degrees will allow for 
heat index values to rise with the highest values over the Coastal
Plains and I-35 corridor. A Heat Advisory continues for these 
locations through this evening. Cloud cover and any shower and 
thunderstorm activity may impede on forecast high 
temperatures/heat indices, but any which way you look at it, 
summer-time heat will be in place. 

Back to rain chances: Guidance shows a disturbance and surface 
boundary moving south-southeast towards the area as early as this 
morning, as evident from activity developing to the north of the 
Waco area as of the writing of this discussion. However, the 
higher and more widespread precipitation chances are seen this 
afternoon and evening with peak heating. Isolated to scattered 
coverage is expected meaning not everyone will receive rain. At 
least some activity could linger overnight into Friday though only
isolated activity is expected during this time. Severe storms are
not likely, though stronger storms could produce gusty wind and 
locally heavy rainfall. Additionally, the return of some seabreeze
showers or storms will be possible Friday. Temperatures on Friday
should decrease a few degrees, though lingering moisture will 
still allow heat index values to approach the 105-108 degree mark 
for some locations.

&&

.LONG TERM...
(Friday night through Wednesday)
Issued at 1220 AM CDT Thu Aug 27 2026

Drier conditions return this weekend as ridging builds back east,
though this feature does look to weaken the latter half of the 
weekend. Guidance indicates a disturbance moves westward towards 
the Texas Gulf coast early next week, though there isn't great 
agreement on timing or its strength. This feature could bring back
some low rain chances to the area, primarily to the east of the 
I-35 corridor, and keep temperatures more seasonably hot than 
compared to the last week. 

&&

.AVIATION...
(12Z TAFS)
Issued at 525 AM CDT Thu Aug 27 2026

VFR conditions should primarily continue but main item to monitor
will be isolated to scattered showers and convection during the
afternoon into this evening. KAUS would be first to see this
potential early to mid-afternoon. Chances then slide southward to
the I-10 corridor and the San Antonio terminals where the storm
chances are highest. The Rio Grande, including KDRT, will be the
latest to see the potential. Each of the TAF sites will feature a
PROB30 group with -TSRA and higher convectively influence winds
for these windows indicated above. Couldn't rule out the brief 
opportunity for MVFR or lower conditions if a shower or storm 
directly impacts a site but confidence is too low to include in 
the TAF package until we are able to track activity approaching 
the site. Otherwise, the cloud cover will increase once activity 
starts to get, majority being of the mid to high level variety. 
Winds outside of convective influences will be light and variable
with shifting directions at different times.

&&

Austin Bergstrom Intl Airport 103  77 100  77 /  30  20  10  10 
New Braunfels Muni Airport    102  75 100  75 /  40  30  20  10 
Burnet Muni Airport           101  75  97  74 /  20  10  10   0 
Del Rio Intl Airport          103  77 100  77 /  10  30  20   0 
Georgetown Muni Airport       102  77  99  77 /  20  10  10   0 
Hondo Muni Airport             99  75  99  74 /  30  30  30  10 
San Marcos Muni Airport       102  76 100  75 /  30  20  20  10 
La Grange - Fayette Regional  101  77  99  76 /  30  30  20  10 
San Antonio Intl Airport      101  78  99  77 /  40  30  20  10 
Stinson Muni Airport          102  79 101  77 /  30  30  20  10 

&&

Heat Advisory until 7 PM CDT this evening for TXZ173-191>194-
205>209-220>225.

&&
